result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but the bottom navigation bar has a visually broken element: a wide dark horizontal bar spanning between the home and profile icons with a bookmark icon floating on it, which appears to be a mis-rendered search tab icon.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the middle tab (presumably Search) is rendered as an odd wide dark horizontal bar with a small bookmark icon on it, instead of a proper search icon/label. It looks broken and inconsistent with the other tabs (home and profile).
issues.suggestion: Fix the bottom nav bar rendering so the search tab displays its icon (e.g., a magnifying glass) and label like the other tabs, without the stray dark bar overlay.

issues.description: Bottom navigation tabs lack text labels, which can reduce clarity for users unfamiliar with the icons.
issues.suggestion: Add labels beneath all bottom navigation icons for clarity and consistency.
